name: Gauge
description: A `ProgressRing` that stops short of a full turn: `sweep` is how far round the dial goes and `start` where it begins, so a value reads as a needle position rather than as a proportion.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How far round the dial goes, in degrees. Three quarters of a turn by default.

props.name: start
props.description: Where it starts, in degrees clockwise from twelve o'clock. Bottom left by default.

props.name: value
props.description: How full the arc is, from 0 to 1. Rounded to half a percent — see `ChartUtils.FRACTION_STEP`.

props.name: thickness
props.description: The width of the ring in view units, out of the 100 the box is wide.

props.name: trackOpacity
props.description: The unfilled part of the ring, as the same colour faded — so the track follows the theme too. Default `0.2`, from the style node.

props.name: preserveAspectRatio
props.description: How the drawing is fitted when the box it is given is a different shape.

props.name: width
props.description: The `width` attribute: a number in user units, or any CSS length — `"100%"`, `"12rem"`.

props.name: height
props.description: The `height` attribute: a number in user units, or any CSS length.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the drawing — `role="img"` and this text. Without one the `<svg>` is `aria-hidden`.

props.name: children
props.description: What is drawn on top of the shape: the number inside a ring, a gradient in a `<Defs>`. SVG content, not a render prop.

a11y: `aria-hidden` with no `label`, and a `label` makes it `role="img"`. The value itself belongs in text: a dial's angle is not readable by anyone who cannot see it.
